svg.title: Mean-shift clusters
svg.desc: Cluster modes of 4 clusters from mean shift, where each cluster is a peak of the estimated density, over 4 variables. The size bar is the share of training rows in each cluster. Each cell is the mode value on the standardised scale, restated as a z-score across the clusters so that variables on different scales compare.
